about: P01 on the report page (docs/report_page.md §3.2): its queries, two inputs, chart and two tables, run by app/report.mjs over the table the page registers after login. The queries read the view as it is; they sum only the columns the metadata calls additive, and never order_count, which counts an order in each of its categories. The chart reads the whole grid of months by root categories, null where a cell has no row, so its lines break there and every month stays on the axis (M63). The partial month — the last, by `partial` — is drawn dashed from the month before and marked as incomplete. Amounts reach the page as exact decimal text, and as DOUBLE only to be drawn.
title: Receita por canal e categoria
question: Qual a receita líquida por mês, canal e categoria de produto?

canais.sql: select distinct sales_channel_name as value from p01 order by 1

meses.sql: select distinct year_month as value from p01 order by 1

raizes.sql: select distinct root_category_name as value from p01 order by 1

por_mes.sql: with meses as (select distinct year_month from p01), raizes as (select distinct root_category_name from p01), f as (select year_month, root_category_name, sum(net_revenue_amount) as v from p01 where ($1 = 'todos' or sales_channel_name = $1) group by year_month, root_category_name) select m.year_month, r.root_category_name, cast(f.v as double) as net_revenue_amount, cast(f.v as varchar) as net_revenue_text from meses m cross join raizes r left join f on f.year_month = m.year_month and f.root_category_name = r.root_category_name order by m.year_month, r.root_category_name

resumo.sql: with cells as (select m.year_month, r.root_category_name from (select distinct year_month from p01) m cross join (select distinct root_category_name from p01) r), filtered as (select year_month, root_category_name, sum(net_revenue_amount) as net_revenue_amount, sum(unit_count) as unit_count from p01 where ($1 = 'todos' or sales_channel_name = $1) group by year_month, root_category_name) select c.year_month, c.root_category_name, cast(f.net_revenue_amount as varchar) as net_revenue_amount, f.unit_count from cells c left join filtered f on f.year_month = c.year_month and f.root_category_name = c.root_category_name order by c.year_month, c.root_category_name

detalhe.sql: select sales_channel_name, category_name, order_count, unit_count, cast(net_revenue_amount as varchar) as net_revenue_amount from p01 where ($1 = 'todos' or sales_channel_name = $1) and year_month = $2 order by sales_channel_name, category_name
